annotation.evidence_span: Implementations MUST NOT exchange data on any stream other than stream 1 without packet protection.
annotation.interpretation_a: Data exchanges on streams other than stream 1 are prohibited unless packet protection is used.
annotation.interpretation_b: Data exchanges on streams other than stream 1 are prohibited entirely, regardless of packet protection.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the prohibition applies only to unprotected exchanges on streams other than stream 1 or to all exchanges on those streams, leaving an incomplete constraint that can lead to different implementation behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: Whether packet protection is required for all streams other than stream 1.
